title: Guidelines / Hola
slide_intent: Give contributors clear routes into a brand system because consistency depends on people finding the guidance they need.
strategic_value: Separating identity, writing, illustration, marketing and resources can help Duolingo coordinate communication across teams.
demonstration: The home page introduces the guide and presents five colored section cards, quick links and site navigation.
practical_value: Choose the relevant guidance area before making a visual or verbal brand decision.

content_islands.name: Welcome
content_islands.spec: Place the greeting and purpose statement above the guide cards.

content_islands.name: Quick links
content_islands.spec: Keep the press, color and website links beside the welcome.

content_islands.name: Guide cards
content_islands.spec: Arrange the five colored destinations with their descriptions and illustrations beneath the introduction.

content_islands.name: Site navigation
content_islands.spec: Retain the top and bottom navigation around the guide content.

reference_purposes.Intent: The introduction says the guidelines unify Duolingo communications across its work.
reference_purposes.Application: Five guide destinations identify where to find identity, writing, illustration, marketing and asset guidance.
